# DigBrushes

**Tags:** `world-system`

Which brush a dig makes: bare hands and each shovel or pick have a shape, a radius and the materials they cut; Mining skill grows the radius up to a cap; the rim is blended; yield is removed volume over a unit volume per material.

> **Goal:** A dig moves a shovelful, not a slab, and the tool decides what it can cut (Phase 300)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `skillRadiusPerTier` | decimal | yes | Metres of brush radius added per Mining skill tier |
| `blend` | decimal | yes | Default smooth-blend k in metres for the rim of a dig |
| `minRadius` | decimal | yes | Under this radius a dig is the single slab (one tile) |
| `workFactor` | decimal | yes | Work time of a brush dig: this fraction of a slab's time per slab-equivalent removed (Phase 259) |
